metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAD Surface Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Comprehensive parameter catalog for Fusion 360 Design workspace surface modeling: gap-filling (Patch), connectivity (Stitch / Unstitch), boundary modification (Trim / Extend), normal correction (Reverse Normal), offset/thickening (Offset Surface / Thicken). Boundary Fill is shipped in feature_operations and not duplicated here. Aligns with Autodesk Fusion 360 Python API SurfaceFeatures module surface.
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help — Design workspace > Surface > Create + Modify panels + Python API SurfaceFeatures reference

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs for surface operations

PATCH.description: Fills a closed boundary curve loop with a surface. Boundary may be a single closed sketch loop, a chain of edges, or a mix. Continuity at boundary is selectable per edge: free / tangent (G1) / curvature (G2). Common for gap-filling imported geometry and lofting non-rectangular regions.

parameters.name: Boundary Curves
parameters.description: Closed loop of edges and/or sketch curves

parameters.name: Per-Edge Continuity
parameters.description: [(edge_index, continuity_type)] overrides for each boundary segment

parameters.name: Interior Curves
parameters.description: Optional internal isoparametric curves to control patch shape

parameters.name: Default Continuity
parameters.description: Continuity at boundary unless overridden per-edge

parameters.name: Continuity Weight
parameters.description: Tangent magnitude (G1/G2 modes)

parameters.name: Plane Constraint
parameters.description: Optional plane the patch must lie tangent to

parameters.name: Smooth Internal Mesh
parameters.description: Add intermediate u-v lines for smoother result

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Surface or solid output

parameters.name: Target Surfaces
parameters.description: Surfaces to stitch into when stitch_into_existing

STITCH.description: Joins multiple surfaces along their shared edges into a single surface body or, if the result is closed, a solid body. Tolerance controls how far apart edges may be and still be considered shared. Failed stitch returns an open body with an error report.

parameters.name: Surfaces
parameters.description: Two or more surfaces to stitch

parameters.name: Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum gap that will still be stitched

parameters.name: Auto-Solid
parameters.description: Convert to solid body if the stitch is closed

parameters.name: Fail On Error
parameters.description: Throw if any edge fails to stitch (vs leaving open)

UNSTITCH.description: Splits a stitched surface body or solid back into individual face surfaces. Reverses Stitch. Useful when imported geometry needs per-face control, or to re-do connectivity with different tolerance.

parameters.name: Faces or Bodies
parameters.description: Faces to unstitch (subset) or whole bodies (all faces)

parameters.name: Chain Selection
parameters.description: Auto-extend along tangent-connected faces

parameters.name: Keep Original
parameters.description: Preserve the stitched body

TRIM_SURFACE.description: Trims a surface using a curve / edge / surface as the trim tool. Selectable side determines which region is removed. Common for cleaning imported surfaces and shaping lofted blends.

parameters.name: Surface
parameters.description: Surface to trim

parameters.name: Trim Tool
parameters.description: Curve / edge / surface / sketch

parameters.name: Region to Remove
parameters.description: Click which side of the trim tool to discard

parameters.name: Extend Trim Tool
parameters.description: Auto-extend a finite trim tool to fully bound the surface

parameters.name: Tangent Chain
parameters.description: Extend selection along tangent edges (curve/edge mode)

parameters.name: Projection Direction
parameters.description: Vector for sketch_projection mode (default = sketch normal)

parameters.name: Keep Both Sides
parameters.description: Output two surfaces (kept + removed) instead of just kept

EXTEND_SURFACE.description: Extends the boundary of a surface outward by a specified distance with selectable end-condition (linear / tangent / natural curvature). Used to make surfaces large enough to act as trim tools, or to reach a target body for thickening.

parameters.name: Edges
parameters.description: Open boundary edges to extend

parameters.name: Tangent Chain
parameters.description: Auto-extend selection along tangent edges

parameters.name: Distance
parameters.description: Extension length (all modes except to_object)

parameters.name: Target Object
parameters.description: Plane / face / body terminator (to_object mode)

parameters.name: Resulting Continuity
parameters.description: How extended region connects to original

parameters.name: Direction Flip
parameters.description: Reverse extension direction (rare — for cycle-failure recovery)

REVERSE_NORMAL.description: Flips the orientation (front/back side) of a surface. No geometry change — only the parametric direction reverses. Important for downstream Thicken (which thickens in the normal direction) and rendering operations.

parameters.name: Surfaces
parameters.description: Surface body / face whose normal will flip

parameters.name: Tangent Chain
parameters.description: Apply to all tangent-connected surfaces

parameters.name: Make Copy
parameters.description: Preserve original orientation as separate body

OFFSET_SURFACE.description: Creates a parallel surface at a specified normal-direction offset from the input. Positive distance = along normal; negative = opposite. Common for shell-like operations on free-form geometry where Shell isn't applicable.

parameters.name: Surfaces
parameters.description: Surfaces / faces to offset

parameters.name: Tangent Chain
parameters.description: Auto-extend selection along tangent edges

parameters.name: Distance
parameters.description: Offset distance (signed: + = along normal)

parameters.name: Both Sides
parameters.description: Generate two offset surfaces, one each side

parameters.name: Approximation Tolerance
parameters.description: Max deviation from true offset (NURBS approximation)

THICKEN.description: Converts a surface body into a solid body with constant or per-face wall thickness. Direction selectable: side_1 (along normal), side_2 (against), symmetric (both). Common for converting imported surface models into manufacturable solids.

parameters.name: Surfaces
parameters.description: Surface bodies to thicken

parameters.name: Per-Face Thickness Overrides
parameters.description: [(face, thickness_mm)] pairs for variable thickness

parameters.name: Thickness
parameters.description: Default thickness

parameters.name: Hollow Result
parameters.description: Output an open-ended thick shell instead of capped solid

parameters.name: Approximation Tolerance
parameters.description: Max NURBS approximation deviation

parameters.name: Target Bodies
parameters.description: Bodies to combine with (join/cut/intersect)

platform_notes.boundary_fill_lives_in_feature_operation: Boundary Fill is the multi-cell solidification primitive — shipped in feature_operations under the Boolean category, not here, to avoid catalog duplication
platform_notes.thicken_direction_depends_on_normal: Thicken's side_1 direction follows the surface normal — flip with REVERSE_NORMAL first if the normal points the wrong way
platform_notes.stitch_tolerance_guideline: Default 0.01 mm matches Fusion's import-tolerance default. Imported STEP/IGES surfaces from older CAD systems may need 0.05-0.1 mm to stitch successfully.
platform_notes.patch_continuity_per_edge: G2 curvature continuity requires that the adjacent surface has consistent curvature direction — degenerate results common at trihedral points
